title: Frigidaire PRMC — System Diagnostic Mode
description: Hold − and + for 10 s; navigate tests with +/−; FREEZE BOOST toggles loads.

steps.title: Enter System Diagnostic Mode
steps.body: Press and hold − and + buttons for 10 seconds. First screens cycle all UI LEDs on, then off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold − and + buttons for 10 seconds. First screens cycle all UI LEDs on, then off.

steps.title: Navigate service tests
steps.body: Use +/− to advance through numbered tests. Press FREEZE BOOST to toggle load states on applicable tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use +/− to advance through numbered tests. Press FREEZE BOOST to toggle load states on applicable tests.

steps.title: Exit service mode
steps.body: Press and hold − and + for 10 seconds, or wait for 10 minutes of inactivity, to return to normal operation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold − and + for 10 seconds, or wait for 10 minutes of inactivity, to return to normal operation.
